description: This Python source file defines payment-related services for a food delivery backend system. It includes data structures, configuration logic, and functions to create and confirm stub payment intents, primarily for testing or placeholder purposes. It interacts with database models such as Order and OrderStatus, and provides a simulated payment confirmation flow that can be replaced with real payment provider APIs in the future.

classes.name: PaymentsConfig
classes.description: Dataclass for holding payment provider configuration, mainly the provider name.

methods.name: PaymentsConfig _get_payments_config()
methods.description: Reads environment variables to determine which payment provider to use, defaults to 'stub'.

methods.name: str _fake_client_secret(order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic fake client secret based on order ID for testing purposes.

methods.name: Order _get_order_or_404(session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches an order by ID from the database, raises 404 HTTPException if not found.

methods.name: tuple[str,int,str] create_payment_intent_stub( session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID, amount_cents: int, )
methods.description: Creates a stub payment intent, validating order status and total amount, returns a fake client secret, amount, and currency.

methods.name: Order confirm_payment_stub( session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID, client_secret: str, )
methods.description: Confirms a stub payment, checks client secret validity, handles order status transition to PAID, or raises errors.
